cues: Copper dissolves slowly in ammonia solution if air is present, giving the deep blue tetrammine copper ion.
It dissolves cellulose, and squirting the solution into acid regenerates the cellulose as fibre: the first artificial silk, rayon.
text: Copper dissolves slowly in ammonia solution if air is present, giving the deep blue tetrammine copper ion. That solution is Schweitzer's reagent. It dissolves cellulose, and squirting the solution into acid regenerates the cellulose as fibre: the first artificial silk, rayon.
